svg.title: Claymark wordmark (dark surfaces)
svg.desc: Identical shape/weight/spacing to wordmark-light.svg — only the color changes, per Checkpoint 6's finding that one static color was never going to survive both themes. Color is the exact dark-theme --text-primary token value (Neutral.n200, hsl(60,3.4%,96%) → #f5f5f4), computed from the real HSL formula, not the "#e8e4dc" placeholder used before this hex-lock pass.
